title: 19649 - 19649/P3193/012691
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
commonCauses:
Intake Manifold Tuning Valve Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G336) faulty
Intake Manifold Runner Control Basic Setting not performed
Intake Manifold Runner Control Basic Setting not performed
Motor for Intake Manifold Flap (V157) faulty
stepByStepSolution:
Kontrol edin:  Intake Manifold Tuning Valve Position Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G336)
Perform Intake Manifold Runner Control Basic Setting
Perform Intake Manifold Runner Control Basic Setting

Kontrol edin:  Motor for Intake Manifold Flap (V157)
Perform Output Test
technicalNotes: When found in Engine: 2.0l TFSI, perform Basic Setting.
